violations.text: Beans was observed held at 112 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food was reheated to above 165 degrees Fahrenheit for hot-holding. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

Packaged raw meat was observed thawing in the sink in stagnant water. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the interior and exterior of the refrigeration units have an accumulation of food residue and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

Dishes and utensils were observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Items were moved to the warewashing area. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024

Hamburgers are served raw or undercooked to the customer's request. A written consumer advisory (on the menu, table tent, or placard) is not provided to the consumer informing them of the significantly increased risk associated with certain vulnerable consumers eating such food in a raw or undercooked form. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024

Reduced oxygen packaged fish was observed thawing with the package in-tact. ROP Fish observed below 38 degrees Fahrenheit. Fish removed from package to properly thaw. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of black debris. New Violation. Correct By: 10/10/2024
